llmJudgeRequirements.reason: preferencesAtom is created with atomWithStorage using createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage) and STORAGE_KEY

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration completion is tracked in dedicated atom state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: A dedicated hydrationCompleteAtom<boolean> tracks hydration state, set to true once AsyncStorage read resolves
evidence: setHydrated(true) called after AsyncStorage.getItem resolves or rejects

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference-dependent content is gated behind a deterministic pre-hydration UI branch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: App renders PreferencesContent (which reads preferencesAtom) only when hydrated is true; otherwise renders a loading spinner

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration action runs first and profile loading is triggered only after hydration completes
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProfilePreviewSection is a child of PreferencesContent and does mount only after hydration, but its fetch is initiated in its own useEffect on mount with no explicit dependency on hydration state — it fetches immediately on render, not triggered by a hydration-completion signal. The sequencing is implicit (component renders post-hydration) rather than an explicit trigger chain where hydration completion causes the profile load.
evidence: ProfilePreviewSection useEffect has empty dependency array []
No reference to hydrationCompleteAtom or hydrated flag inside ProfilePreviewSection or its fetch logic

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Post-hydration profile load fetches the users endpoint and builds preview text from `firstName` and `lastName`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: fetchProfile calls https://dummyjson.com/users/1 and maps data.firstName and data.lastName into the profile state, which is rendered as '{profile?.firstName} {profile?.lastName}'

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference toggle actions update persisted state through functional atom updater paths
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both toggleTheme and toggleCompact call setPreferences with a functional updater (previous) => ({...}) pattern
